bgremove.errorNetwork: The AI model couldn’t be downloaded from this website or from the backup source. Check your connection. If an ad blocker, antivirus or firewall is active, allow this site, huggingface.co and cdn.jsdelivr.net, then try again.

desktopPage.metaTitle: Toolbox Desktop for Windows – Free Download
desktopPage.metaDescription: Download Toolbox Desktop for Windows 10 and 11: image tools, background removal, chart and infographic design, colour tools and more, processed on your computer.
desktopPage.title: Toolbox Desktop
desktopPage.subtitle: Your favorite tools, directly on your computer.
desktopPage.description: Access Toolbox tools from a dedicated desktop application with convenient file handling, professional workflows, and regular updates.
desktopPage.comingSoon: The Windows app is being tested and will be available here soon.
desktopPage.exeHint: Recommended. Installs for your user account, no administrator rights needed.
desktopPage.msiHint: For IT administrators and installing for all users.
desktopPage.verifyHint: After downloading, you can compare the file’s SHA-256 checksum with the one shown here (PowerShell: Get-FileHash <file> -Algorithm SHA256).

desktop.title: A real desktop app
desktop.text: Its own window, sidebar navigation, keyboard shortcuts and the native Windows save dialog.

local.title: Files stay on your PC
local.text: Images, data and designs are processed on your computer and never uploaded.

designer.title: Chart & infographic designer
designer.text: Create charts, KPI cards and infographics, then export PNG, JPG, SVG or PDF.

background.title: AI background removal
background.text: Remove photo backgrounds on your computer. The AI model is downloaded once, then reused.

images.title: Image, colour and text tools
images.text: Compress, resize and convert images, build palettes and patterns, count and clean text.

offline.title: Works offline
offline.text: After installation, the tools work without internet. Only the first use of the background remover needs a connection.

fast.title: Quick access
fast.text: Favourites, recently used tools and your saved design projects on the home screen.

languages.title: English, French and Arabic
languages.text: Full right-to-left support for Arabic, with Arabic fonts in the designer.

requirements.webview: Microsoft Edge WebView2 runtime (included in Windows 11; the installer adds it if missing)
requirements.internet: Internet connection for the download, and once for the background-removal model
requirements.storage: Free disk space for the app, plus about 135 MB if you use the background remover

desktopPage.requirementsNote: Minimum hardware requirements will be published after testing on a range of computers.

notes.n2: All Toolbox tools run locally, including the Chart & Infographic Designer.
notes.n3: Background remover with a verified, one-time model download.
notes.n4: Native save dialog, favourites, recent tools and local design projects.
notes.n5: English, French and Arabic, with right-to-left layout.

download.title: Download
download.text: Click “Download for Windows” to get the .exe installer.

verify.title: Check the file (optional)
verify.text: Compare its SHA-256 checksum with the one on this page.

run.title: Run the installer
run.text: Open the downloaded file, choose your language and follow the steps.

open.title: Open Toolbox
open.text: Start Toolbox from the Start menu or the desktop shortcut.

update.title: Updates
update.text: New versions are published on this page. Install a new version over the old one; your projects are kept.

uninstall.title: Uninstall
uninstall.text: Go to Settings → Apps → Installed apps, find Toolbox and choose Uninstall. Your projects are kept unless you choose to delete app data.

smartscreen.a: SmartScreen warns about apps that are new or not yet code-signed. Only continue if you downloaded the installer from this page and its SHA-256 checksum matches; then choose “More info” and “Run anyway”. If anything does not match, delete the file and do not run it.

webview.a: Toolbox uses Microsoft Edge WebView2 to display its interface. Stay connected to the internet so the installer can add it, or install it from Microsoft.

model.q: The background remover cannot download its model
model.a: Check your internet connection and firewall. The model is downloaded once; after that the tool works offline.

update.a: Download the latest version from this page and install it over your current version. Automatic updates are planned for a future version.
